description.title: תוספת ביטוח - תקופת דיווח מורחבת
description.summary: This table details the conditions for an extended reporting period following cancellation or non-renewal of insurance. It outlines the premium required and the timeframe for reporting claims.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את התנאים להארכת תקופת הדיווח לאחר ביטול או אי חידוש הביטוח. ניתן להאריך את תקופת הדיווח ב־180 יום בתשלום תוספת של 75% מהפרמיה השנתית, בתנאי שהתביעה נובעת מאירוע שהתרחש במהלך תקופת הביטוח. תוספת זו אינה ניתנת להחזר. ביטוח חבות משולב לחברות תוכנה וחומרה מאפשר תקופת דיווח מורחבת. תנאי הפוליסה כוללים תשלום של 75% מהפרמיה השנתית, ומועד תשלום של 30 יום ממועד אי החידוש. תקופת הדיווח המורחבת היא 180 יום.
product_hints: ביטוח חבות משולב לחברות תוכנה וחומרה

sketch:
ENDORSEMENT B
Extended Reporting - Period Option
If, for any reason other than non-payment of premium, the Company cancel or refuse to renew this insurance, the Insured may:
By giving written notice to the Company on or before the effective date of the cancellation or no later than 10 days after the effective date of non-renewal; and
Upon payment of an additional premium of 75% of the annual premium, such premium to be non refundable and paid to the Company within 30 days of the non-renewal
Secure an extended reporting period of 180 days following the effective date of such  cancellation  or  non-renewal,  to  report  Claims  which  may  be  made against  the  Insured.  Such  Claims  shall  be  deemed  to  have  been  made  and reported during the Period of Insurance, but only if the act or omission giving rise to the Claim occurred:
During the Period of Insurance; and
Prior to the effective date of cancellation or non-renewal
All other provisions of this insurance, including those relating to the Limit of Liability are unchanged by this provision.

Secure an extended reporting period of 180 days following the effective date of such  cancellation  or  non-renewal,  to  report  Claims  which  may  be  made against  the  Insured.  Such  Claims  shall  be  deemed  to  have  been  made  and reported during the Period of Insurance, but only if the act or omission giving rise to the Claim occurred:
During the Period of Insurance; and
Prior to the effective date of cancellation or non-renewal
